# Neural Link undo — TransactionService in-heap stack core (Slice-1 foundation)

## Context

The unblocked foundation of neomjs/neo#13221 (NL mutation undo, Slice-1). Splitting neomjs/neo#13221: its capture-hook + `undo` tool are **blocked-by neomjs/neo#13226** (the InstanceService enforcement grant-gate, at the human-merge-gate), but the in-heap transaction-stack **core** depends on neither the grant-gate nor the `(agentId,sessionId)` context — it is a pure stack authority, buildable + unit-provable in isolation, exactly as `LockRegistry` (#13125) / `WriteGuard` (#13134) / `resolveWriteLock` (#13208) shipped as standalone cores before their wiring. This ticket ships that core now; neomjs/neo#13221 retains the capture-hook + `undo`-tool wiring on top, once neomjs/neo#13226 merges.

Graduated shape: Discussion #13216 (§6.2 quorum). OQ2-C (in-memory now), the reverse-record schema (OQ1+OQ5), the `open→committed→undone`/`aborted`/`timedOut` state machine, and the caps are the converged ACs implemented here.

## The Architectural Reality

`Neo.ai.TransactionService` is a per-heap, in-heap authority owned by `Neo.ai.Client` (sibling to `Neo.ai.WriteGuard`) — `src/ai/TransactionService.mjs`. It is the **active** undo stack, distinct by design from the forward-only `RecorderService` / `nl_action_log` audit ledger (D#13216 STEP_BACK neomjs/neo#7). Pure over its inputs (reverse-capture, the enforcement grant, and the live tree live in the caller), so it is unit-testable via event sequences with no live-heap or socket dependency.

## The Fix

`src/ai/TransactionService.mjs` + `test/playwright/unit/ai/TransactionService.spec.mjs`. State: per-session `Map` keyed by `{neuralLinkSessionId, requesterAgentId, requesterSessionId}` → `{open, committed[]}`. Lifecycle API: `begin` / `record` / `commit` / `undo` / `abort` / `sweep` / `stackOf`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `begin → record → commit → undo` round-trips a transaction; `undo` returns the reverse-ops in **reverse capture order** (last mutation undone first), single-level (most-recent committed).
- [x] Each op stores `originWriter:{agentId, sessionId}` (provenance only) + `targetSubtreePath` (audit only) + `sequenceId` + `forward`/`reverse` + `label`; provenance is preserved through undo.
- [x] State machine: `open → committed → undone`, `aborted` (failure/teardown), with empty transactions dropped (not undoable). `begin` aborts a prior still-open transaction (no leak).
- [x] Fail-closed: incomplete session identity / empty `txId` (`begin`); no-open / `txId` mismatch (`record`/`commit`); malformed op; **non-serializable (cyclic) reverse** (data-not-code guard); the caps below.
- [x] Caps (config, overridable): `maxStackDepth` (oldest committed evicted past it — no longer undoable), `maxOpsPerTransaction`, `maxReversePayloadBytes`.
- [x] Per-session isolation (two writers → separate stacks); `sweep` retires a session entirely (the transaction-side of `WriteGuard.releaseAgent`, fail-closed on incomplete identity).
- [x] `stackOf` returns a deep copy (mutating it never affects the live stack).
- [x] Unit spec green (16 tests).

## Out of Scope (→ neomjs/neo#13221, post-#13226-merge)

- The `InstanceService` capture-hook (post-enforcement-grant reverse-capture) — blocked-by neomjs/neo#13226.
- The `undo` Neural Link tool (6-site wiring) + the e2e — neomjs/neo#13221.
- `redo` + named batching (Slice-2), Memory-Core persistence (Slice-3), `systemRollback` — later neomjs/neo#9848 children.

- 2026-06-14T13:43:38Z @neo-opus-vega referenced in commit `e08c761` - "fix(ai): tighten TransactionService.record validation + implement timeout terminal (#13230)

Addresses the cross-family REQUEST_CHANGES on the PR. Two contract-level gaps closed:

1) Malformed-op fail-closed: record() now validates EVERY required reverse-record field before cloneOp (sequenceId, originWriter.{agentId,sessionId}, non-empty targetSubtreePath of non-empty string segments, forward, reverse, non-empty bounded label) and guards BOTH forward AND reverse JSON-serializability in one try/catch -> a missing field, a non-string, a cyclic/function descriptor, an over-cap payload, or an over-long label all return {ok:false} and NEVER store undefined nor throw downstream. Previously only originWriter/targetSubtreePath/reverse were checked and only reverse serializability was guarded, so a cyclic forward threw an uncaught TypeError inside cloneOp and missing sequenceId/forward/label stored silently.

2) timedOut terminal: implemented the timeout({id,txId}) lease-expiry transition (open -> timedOut), mirroring abort but recorded as its own auditable cause. The class JSDoc named timedOut as a state-machine terminal with no implementation; it is now real and tested.

Config: renamed maxReversePayloadBytes -> maxOpPayloadBytes (the cap bounds each of forward/reverse, not just reverse) and added maxLabelChars (default 200). Reasons renamed accordingly: reverse-not-serializable -> op-not-serializable, max-reverse-payload-bytes -> max-op-payload-bytes; added max-label-length.

Tests: 16 -> 18 green. Extended the malformed-op case to all required fields, the serializability + payload caps to both descriptors, and added over-long-label + timeout-terminal coverage."
